draft.title: Considering KokoroSharp for Offline AI Voice Chat: How Mature Is It Really?
draft.body:
I came across a report from early 2025 about KokoroSharp, a local TTS engine developed in response to a new high-performance audio model called Kokoro. The author was building a fully offline AI voice chat app and pivoted to create this cross-platform TTS engine, which was about 90% ready at the time.

Given that the exact performance details and stability of KokoroSharp aren’t fully documented, I’m curious about how suitable it might be for offline AI voice chat projects today. Has anyone here explored KokoroSharp further or integrated it into similar setups? What practical challenges or limitations did you encounter, especially regarding audio quality or processing reliability?

Understanding these tradeoffs would help decide if KokoroSharp is a viable foundation or if alternative offline TTS solutions should be prioritized.
